# context-inbox

> A framework for turning messages from any source into cited changes in any destination. An agent drafts each change, a person approves it on a claude.ai review page, and the next run writes only approved changes.

Each project keeps `config.json` and `RULES.md` in a separate private repo. The config maps channels to destinations. Projects add their own readers and guides there, next to the config.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): set up a project, then the daily run, step by step.
- [RULES.md](RULES.md): what a proposal is, how to write it, and its JSON shape.
- [config.example.json](config.example.json): config shape, with built-in, custom and connector sources.

## Plug-in points

- [sources/README.md](sources/README.md): reader arguments, message format, and reading through a connector.
- [destinations/README.md](destinations/README.md): the four things a destination guide must say.

## Built in

- [sources/slack.py](sources/slack.py): Slack reader, thread replies included.
- [destinations/linear.md](destinations/linear.md): Linear issues and comments.
- [destinations/attio.md](destinations/attio.md): Attio deal notes and tasks.
- [destinations/github.md](destinations/github.md): one commit per item to a repo.
- [review.html](review.html): the review page.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): overview and manual setup for people.
